Our school关于学校

Roots in Chinese.
A home in Denmark.扎根中华文化，
在丹麦一起成长。

Founded by parents, Lyngby Chinese School brings families together around language and culture. A parent-elected board supports teaching and organises community activities.灵比中文学校由家长共同创办，以语言与文化连接家庭。家长代表选举产生的理事会支持教学并组织课余活动。

Room to find a voice给表达留出空间

The curriculum develops recognition, expression, reading and writing step by step.课程循序渐进，发展识字、表达、阅读与写作能力。

Culture through participation在参与中感受文化

Stories, poetry and traditions connect language learning with cultural understanding.通过故事、诗词与传统，将语言学习与文化理解相结合。

For parents家长问答

A few things you
might be wondering.您可能想了解的事。

Still have a question?还有其他问题？
Can my child start without speaking Chinese?不会中文，也能入学吗？

The early-years programme is designed for children aged 4–5 with no Chinese. For an older beginner, ask the school which class is suitable.启蒙班面向4–5岁零基础儿童。年龄较大的初学者，请向学校咨询适合的班级。

How is the right grade chosen?如何选择合适年级？

Contact the school about your child’s age, spoken Chinese, reading and writing experience. Ask for placement advice rather than choosing solely by age.请向学校介绍孩子的年龄、口语、识字与写作情况，并咨询分班建议，不必只按年龄选择。

Can we visit or try a lesson first?可以先参观或试听吗？

Contact the school to ask about a visit or trial lesson and available spaces before arriving.请发邮件至 the school 咨询参观、试听及名额，并在到校前与学校约定。

Where do lessons take place?在哪里上课？

Fuglsanggårdsskolen, Askevænget 10, 2830 Virum. Use the directions link below and confirm the classroom with your teacher.地址为 Fuglsanggårdsskolen，Askevænget 10，2830 Virum。可使用下方导航链接，并向老师确认教室。

What should my child bring?孩子需要带什么？

Ask the class teacher about books and supplies. AI students need an internet-ready laptop or iPad and their own email account for AI tools.教材及文具请向班级老师确认。AI课程需自备可联网电脑或iPad，以及用于注册工具的电子邮箱。

What happens during holidays or if we miss a lesson?假期或缺课怎么办？

Use the school calendar for holiday dates. Contact your teacher about an absence and ask how to catch up.假期安排请查看校历。缺课时请联系老师，并咨询如何补上学习内容。

How can parents get involved?家长可以如何参与？

Parents elect the school board and help shape the school community. Ask about activities, volunteering and the association’s general meeting.家长选举学校理事会，并参与社区建设。欢迎咨询活动、志愿服务及协会会员大会。
